by the force of great intensity you come to your own true nature
break open the two boards and you enter the great void
swallow the pairs and you stand in the knowing that leaves room for nothing else
when the siddhas and the yoginis meet the great union arises
drop the three coverings and you abide in what cannot be named
where the four speeches rise and pause the original sound shines
taste the three essences and the boundless rises on its own free of every bond
when the four goddesses rejoice you rest in your own ground for good
when the twelve currents rise the great rays of consciousness open out
when the five modes of conduct emerge you enter the waveless state
enter the great awakening and the grip of good and evil loosens
by speech beyond speech you reach the mudra of great wonder the resonance of the void
coming to your own true nature
the great void, full not empty
essence, the taste of a thing
the two halves of one power
the three ways: self-effort, energy, grace
the seal that moves in open sky
the pairs every experience splits into
the principles of reality, 36 in this school
the tradition this text belongs to
the equal taste of everything in one
